test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Who has taken away my pen?

options.text: By whom has my pen been taken away?
By whom had my pen been taken away?
By whom is my pen taken away?
By whom was my pen taken away?

solution:
The correct answer is: **By whom has my pen been taken away?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.
 
• The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.
 
• The preposition “by” is used before the object made in Passive Voice. However, it is optional in some cases.
 
• The question in Active voice is in **interrogative form**. These are “wh” questions that don’t take “yes” or “no” as an answer.
 
• **“Who” **is changed into by **“By whom?”**
 
• Also, the **verb **is placed before the subject in the Passive Voice.
 
• For example:
 
 
• Who has taught you Math? (Active)
 
• By whom have you been taught Math? (Passive)
 
 
 
• Also, the sentence is in the **Present Perfect tense** in the Active voice. So, in the Passive voice, the **Present Perfect tense** should be used.
 
• The options except (1) don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *By whom has my pen been taken away?*
